responsibility: This file implements DynamicStrings-based wrappers around the core FIO file-opening and line/string transfer routines. It converts dynamic string filenames into the raw form expected by FIO, returns FIO_File handles for existence tests and opens, writes entire dynamic strings with direct byte counts, and reads a line into a newly built dynamic string while consuming the trailing newline, making it the bridge between the heap-string subsystem and buffered file I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of GSFIO: it translates DynamicStrings filenames and contents into the lower-level FIO calls for open, existence checks, whole-string writes, and line reads, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSFIO.h only declares those wrapper entry points.
